selection_method: deterministic seeded selection across seven independently authored editorial axes

axes.background: decommissioned coastal hydrographic observatory with cobalt tile, brass grating, and a specimen archive
axes.occupation_and_action: 34-year-old adult textile conservator pivoting from an open specimen drawer to intercept a swinging tide-gauge calibration ribbon
axes.props: brass tide gauge, hanging calibration ribbon, open specimen drawer, rolled hydrographic chart
axes.camera: low three-quarter full-body viewpoint with a 50 mm documentary-fashion perspective and crisp high-shutter timing
axes.lighting: cool lighthouse slats crossing warm tungsten archive-lamp light
axes.wardrobe_material: opaque garnet bias-cut satin coatdress over a high-neck shell

motion_geometry.travel_direction: clockwise from the specimen drawer toward the tide gauge
motion_geometry.start_marker: open specimen drawer behind the still-turning torso
motion_geometry.unfinished_destination: ribbon knot one handspan beyond the reaching fingertips
motion_geometry.support_path: fully planted left foot, lifting right heel, and bent right knee continuing toward the instrument
motion_geometry.attention_target: alert eyes fixed on the ribbon knot
motion_geometry.directional_lag: satin hem, one loose hair strand, reaching fingers, and calibration ribbon trailing the same clockwise travel

content_boundary: clearly adult, fully clothed, non-explicit fashion editorial; reference supplies facial appearance only
selected_concept: Pre-dawn hydrographic-archive fashion editorial: an adult textile conservator is frozen midway through a measured clockwise pivot from an open specimen drawer toward a swinging brass calibration ribbon, with support geometry, attentive target gaze, and material lag all readable in one frame.
